main_measure.name: mean excess 3-bar return after Sunday bars with forecast >= 2
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 100 cases and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 100 cases

supporting_check.name: forecast-weighted mean excess minus unweighted mean

decided_by: Mean excess 3-bar return positive with t >= 2 over at least 100 cases, and the forecast-weighted mean exceeds the unweighted mean.
reading: A case is any bar whose UTC start timestamp is a Sunday with forecast >= 2 and a full 3-bar return inside its window, the coin's normal drift is the mean of its 3-bar returns on each window's grid 0,3,6,... over all its windows, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' is reported as not observable per the workflow.
